Minecraft LAN Flasher

Puts the Minecraft-LAN Wi-Fi network firmware on an ESP32. Nothing to install: this page talks to the board directly. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.

  1. Plug the ESP32 into a USB-A port with a data cable (on USB-C boards, try both plug orientations if nothing shows up).
  2. Click the button, pick the board's port in the popup (usually USB-SERIAL CH340 or CP210x).
  3. Wait about a minute. The board is erased, programmed, and restarted.
Ready.

After flashing: unplug, power the board from any USB charger, join Wi-Fi Minecraft-LAN (password minecraft). Status page: http://192.168.4.1.

If the popup says "Failed to connect" or "Wrong boot mode": hold the board's BOOT button while clicking the button, release after it says Connecting. Boards without buttons: wire IO0 to GND while plugging in.
